body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: A compact underground storeroom with two mismatched timber lofts separated by a narrow void. Domestic life occupies one bright shelf; the mage is under the other in opaque shadow. A trapdoor at the back is the dungeon route. COMPOSITION: Side section of a sloping attic: one wide shelf over three shallow niches with mismatched fabric doors. COLOR SCRIPT: muted indigo, cool gray stone, dusty rose cloth, small honey lights. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
